ratings_why.fun: Over a 7 because it bridges into other tribes at every tier: Curfew Warden sleeps any carry, Ottilie doubles any Start of Combat card, Wechselbalg Discovers the host's tribe, and how many slots to leave empty is a real bet every turn.
ratings_why.distinct: Over a 7 because it plays on the enemy's board and feeds on their size: Eggs on their units, Chicks that shove past Bitter and Bristle, and a fight clock no current tribe has.

verdict_why: The engine is in a good spot; one or two lines of rules text around Ottilie and stacked Eggs still read two ways.

points.text: Under Grand Horologe Ottilie, does Curfew Warden's sleep happen at Start of Combat, and does it then also repeat twice at the Hour (two +3/+3 wakes)? "Falling Asleep doesn't wait" covers the sleep but not the rest of the Warden's effect.

When a host carries several Eggs and the first Chick's shove kills it, are the other Eggs lost or already hatched? Golden Dunnock-Line Fledgling and golden Kasimir hit this every fight; say all Eggs on a host hatch before any shove.
Frau Wechselbalg could let you pick which hatched Chick's host to Discover from when several hatched, which turns scouting the enemy's tribes into a pivot choice.

Glirarium Keeper's second trigger mostly lands only on Old Unruh, since other sleepers wake at the first Hour. A sleeper that re-sleeps (or a Warden that can sleep a woken unit again) would give the Vault half a second lever.
Nest-Box Dormouse is the only bridge from the Egg half to the Sleeping half; one more card that turns Chicks into sleepers or sleepers into Layers would knot the two builds together.

standouts.why: Delay-and-double turns the tribe into a multiplier for the lobby's best Start of Combat cards, and stacks with Wind and Kasimir.
Steals the opponent's tribe as Discovers, so the splash pivots into whatever you fought.
Hides on the biggest enemy and comes back with its stats; with Mother Rohrsang he takes all of them, and Reed-Line's early hatch rescues him.

weakest.why: Wind 2 is a pure dial with no effect of its own; it matters only through other cards.
A sleeper with a small wake buff; it does the expected job and little else.
Gold for the Hour striking; the third-strike bonus helps but it is still a plain economy body.

flags.note: Golden Hour-Keeper (every attack) with Door Cuckoo and Old Unruh makes an Hour per attack; caps and room limit it, but it needs a sim.
Which parts of Curfew Warden's effect wait and repeat under Ottilie.
Golden Mother Rohrsang with Little Gernegroß gives twice the biggest enemy's stats plus a shove of that size.
Which host's tribe she Discovers from when several Chicks hatched.
